datasets.name: Human amygdala
datasets.description: Visium, Visium HD and Xenium sections with Banksy spatial domains, RCTD cell type weights and a basolateral amygdala snRNA-seq reference.

datasets.name: Human DLPFC (spatialDLPFC)
datasets.description: 30 Visium sections spanning anterior, middle and posterior DLPFC with data-driven layer domains and paired snRNA-seq.

datasets.name: Human DLPFC pilot (spatialLIBD)
datasets.description: The original 12-section Visium dataset with manually annotated layers that launched spatialLIBD.

paper.title: Maynard, Collado-Torres et al., Nature Neuroscience 2021

datasets.name: Human hippocampus
datasets.description: Hippocampal formation across 10 donors with subfield and neuropil domains, plus immunofluorescence-guided Visium-SPG sections.

datasets.name: Human locus coeruleus
datasets.description: Norepinephrine neurons of the brainstem locus coeruleus on Visium with matched single-nucleus profiles.

datasets.name: Human habenula
datasets.description: Medial and lateral habenula across donors with and without schizophrenia.

datasets.name: Human nucleus accumbens
datasets.description: Single-nucleus atlas of ventral striatum with medium spiny neuron subtypes.

datasets.name: Mouse amygdala (Visium HD)
datasets.description: 8 µm Visium HD bins across the mouse amygdala for cross-species comparison with the human atlas.

datasets.name: Human DLPFC (Xenium)
datasets.description: Single-cell resolution layer architecture of DLPFC with a 480-gene brain panel.
